en.name: Ripple Effect
en.title: Ripple Effect: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A headline sits in a glowing spectral ring that ripples, then rings expand and reveal the product. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
howto: Draw the title ring on a canvas redrawn from timeline time. The base radius is 380px with four strokes 26/11/5/2.2px wide and a 24-stop conic gradient whose hue runs twice around the ring. Grow it over 0.1–1.7s with expo.out, and make the edge wobble with three sines of 5, 8 and 13 lobes at 3.2–5.6px. Echo rings are born at 0.9s and every 0.8s after, grow from 402px to 732px radius over 2.8s with cubic.out and fade, and each birth pushes the main ring out 7px. The headline Silence, tuned to you. is 88px, weight 700, and blurs in from 0.5s.

Reveal the next scene with five clip-path circles centred on the ring. Circle k opens at 4.7 + 0.14k seconds with radius 1320 × (1 − 2^(−10p)) over 2.0s, and each holds a full copy of the product scene, starting magnified 1.30x down to 1.06x so the rings read as a tunnel. First contract the ring 5.5% over 4.4–4.7s and raise the fringe energy at 3.9–4.6s. The case lands at 4.75s and the earbuds at 4.8s and 4.9s, so the product is already settling when the rings reveal it.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the ring, the five reveal circles and the product from your own product. At 7.3s let the product recede and draw the mark, wordmark Hush and tagline from 7.55s. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.
faq: What is a ripple effect in a product film?

A ripple effect sends rings outward from a point, like a wave in water or sound. In this film a ring around a headline swells and sends out echoes, then concentric rings expand from the centre and each one shows the next scene, so the title turns into the product.
How do you make rings that reveal the next scene?

Stack one copy of the next scene per ring and give each copy a circular clip-path centred on the frame. Animate the radius with expo.out, start each ring a little after the one before it, and draw a glowing stroke at every radius. The outer ring leaves first and the innermost copy ends up covering the frame.

zh.name: 波纹效果
zh.title: 波纹效果：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 标题停在发光的彩色环里，环轻轻起伏并放出回波，随后一圈圈环向外展开，圆环里露出产品。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个波纹效果。
howto: 标题环用 canvas 画，每帧按时间线时间重绘。基础半径 380px，四层描边宽 26/11/5/2.2px，颜色是 24 个节点的锥形渐变，色相绕环转两圈。0.1–1.7s 用 expo.out 长到全尺寸，边缘按 5、8、13 瓣三个正弦起伏，幅度 3.2–5.6px。回波环从 0.9s 起每隔 0.8s 生一圈，用 2.8s 和 cubic.out 从半径 402px 扩到 732px 并淡出，每圈出生时主环向外顶 7px。标题 Silence, tuned to you. 88px，字重 700，0.5s 起从模糊淡入。

用 5 个以环心为圆心的 clip-path 圆揭示下一个场景。第 k 个圆 4.7 + 0.14k 秒开始，用 2.0s 把半径按 1320 × (1 − 2^(−10p)) 展开，每个圆里是一整份产品场景，分别先放大 1.30 倍到 1.06 倍，圈和圈之间像一条隧道。先让环在 4.4–4.7s 收缩 5.5%，3.9–4.6s 加强锯齿边的能量。机盒 4.75s 落位，耳机 4.8s 和 4.9s 落位，所以圈揭示产品时产品已经在落定。
点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会用你的产品做出环、5 个揭示圆和产品场景。7.3s 让产品退到背景，7.55s 起画出符号、字标 Hush 和标语。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。
faq: 产品片里的波纹效果是什么？
波纹效果让一圈圈环从一个点向外扩散，像水波或声波。这支片子里标题外的环起伏并放出回波，接着一圈圈同心环从中心向外展开，每个圈里露出下一个场景，标题于是变成产品。
怎么做出能揭示下一个场景的环？
每个环放一份下一个场景的副本，给每份副本一个以画面中心为圆心的圆形 clip-path。半径用 expo.out 展开，每个环比前一个晚一点开始，并在每个半径上画一圈发光描边。外圈先离开画面，最内层的副本最终盖住整个画面。
